Political Facebook Advertising in Bangladesh

TICON System Limited runs political Facebook advertising across Bangladesh for parties, candidates and advocacy groups. The company handles audience research, creative production, compliance review and daily budget management, then reports reach, cost per result and sentiment in Bangladeshi taka so campaign teams can decide quickly what actually works.
What does it cost?
Campaigns start at BDT 50,000 monthly.
Which cities?
All 64 districts, with focus on Dhaka and Chattogram.
How fast?
Setup completes within five working days.
